messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing.ledger.fractional_gap triggered for window 2026-03-18T02:00Z. observed small delta across aggregator shards that is flipping overage thresholds for a subset of low-volume customers. Routed to @andy (oncall). runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/billing-ledger

andy (oncall): Got it, on my way. Any confirmed customer impact yet?

sam (metering-eng): quick triage: shard-12 shows a tiny positive delta vs primary. Magnitude small (~0.001 tokens per shard aggregate) but enough to cross rounding thresholds for low-volume accounts. sample snapshot: 
```
sum_tokens_shard_12=1234567.0012
sum_tokens_primary=1234567.0000
delta=0.0012
percent=0.00097%
```

mei (billing-sre): hmm fractional residues. Could be float->decimal change from the emitter rollout last week. Which stream produced those records?

sam (metering-eng): looks like eu-cust-stream emitter v2 is now emitting counts as floats (we updated proto serialized field). Aggregator normally canonicalizes to ints but a quantization path for some shards left fractional remainders.

andy (oncall): Priority: 1) stop outbound overage notifications, 2) run targeted reconcile for affected window, 3) determine rollback/patch. Aly, can you confirm email volume?

aly (support): Confirmed: 2 customers received overage emails at ~02:12Z. Both are low-volume and borderline. I've paused CS outreach for now.

jess (product): If we're sure these are false positives, we should suppress further emails until reconcile completes.

sam (metering-eng): I'll run a propose reconcile for 02:00Z-02:15Z to preview fixes. Command I will run: 
```
./tools/reconcile-ledger --shard 12 --start 2026-03-18T02:00Z --end 2026-03-18T02:15Z --fix-mode=propose
```
I'll post the diff.

mei (billing-sre): I'll flip the console flag to suppress overage notifications while we triage: `billing.suppress_overage_notifications=true` (global). We should scope it to a short window and audit who touches it.

andy (oncall): OK proceed. Keep me posted on ETA.

[sam runs reconcile]

sam (metering-eng): reconcile (propose) finished: diffs look tiny but normalize the totals. preview: 
```
customerA: +0.0009 -> rounded down -> no overage
customerB: +0.0011 -> rounded down -> no overage
```
Applying now with `--fix-mode=apply`.

incident-bot: Action log: reconcile job 43912 started by sam at 02:18Z, completed at 02:25Z. results=applied; corrected=2 accounts; drift_magnitude=~0.0012 tokens/shard.

mei (billing-sre): Verified post-apply ledger snapshots; shard totals now match primary within float tolerance. Suppression flag set. No further emails emitted.

aly (support): Confirmed: no new overage emails since suppression. CS will retract the two outbound notices once we confirm final state.

andy (oncall): Root cause hypothesis: emitter v2 started sending counts as floats and the aggregator's quantization path left tiny residues on certain shards. Sam/Mei please open RCA ticket with proposed permanent fix (force integer cast at emitter + contract tests).

sam (metering-eng): Creating GH issue INF-7893 with logs, shard list, and suggested fixes (cast at emitter, aggregator regression test). Also adding a quick check to the CI that fails if counts are non-integer in the stream.

jess (product): Timeline for a deployable fix? Any chance of reoccurrence overnight?

sam (metering-eng): Patch for emitter ready in draft PR. Aim to canary deploy tomorrow morning. Short-term mitigation: keep suppression active for 2h while we watch.

mei (billing-sre): I'll also add an audit job to run across all shards for the last 24h to detect similar fractional residues and schedule a follow-up runbook update.

andy (oncall): Monitoring window set to 2 hours. If stable, we'll revert suppression and close the pager. Thanks for the quick work.

incident-bot: Pager closed by andy (oncall) at 04:30Z after 2h monitoring; post-checks OK. Follow-up ticket INF-7893 created.
